modules.title: Unit 1: Survival: Verbs with Gerund & Infinitive
modules.objective: Mampu menggunakan verb patterns dengan gerund dan infinitive secara tepat, memahami perbedaan makna pada verb seperti remember, forget, regret, try, dan stop, serta menguasai kosakata untuk mendeskripsikan perasaan tidak nyaman dan gerakan (verbs of movement).

theory.summary: Unit ini membahas penggunaan verb patterns dalam bahasa Inggris, khususnya kata kerja yang diikuti oleh gerund (-ing) atau infinitive (to + verb). Beberapa kata kerja seperti imagine, suggest, enjoy selalu diikuti gerund, sementara decide, hope, promise, manage selalu diikuti infinitive. Kata kerja begin, start, dan continue bisa diikuti keduanya tanpa perubahan makna. Yang menarik, kata kerja seperti remember, forget, regret, try, dan stop memiliki makna berbeda tergantung apakah diikuti gerund atau infinitive.
rules: Verb + gerund: imagine, feel like, suggest, practice, miss, can't stand, enjoy, detest, don't mind → Contoh: I enjoy climbing mountains.
Verb + infinitive: manage, want, decide, refuse, hope, promise, ask, learn, expect, afford, offer, choose → Contoh: They decided to descend the mountain.
Verb + gerund OR infinitive (tanpa perubahan makna): begin, start, continue → Contoh: He started climbing / He started to climb (sama artinya).
Remember + gerund = mengingat pengalaman masa lalu → Contoh: I remember eating a sandwich during a Maths class once.
Remember + infinitive = jangan lupa melakukan sesuatu → Contoh: Remember to take a snack with you wherever you go.
Forget + gerund = tidak lagi memikirkan sesuatu yang sudah dilakukan → Contoh: He'll never forget meeting Sandra for the first time.
Forget + infinitive = tidak berpikir untuk melakukan sesuatu yang seharusnya dilakukan → Contoh: He forgot to meet Sandra.
Regret + gerund = merasa menyesal tentang sesuatu yang sudah dilakukan → Contoh: I regret telling you that you're run out of time.
Regret + infinitive = merasa menyesal harus mengatakan atau melakukan sesuatu sekarang/masa depan → Contoh: I really regret to tell Jim.
Try + gerund = sulit melihat apakah kamu bisa melakukan sesuatu yang sebenarnya tidak mudah → Contoh: Try to relax before the test.
Try + infinitive = melakukan dan melihat apa hasilnya → Contoh: Try looking as if you're with some friends.
Stop + gerund = berhenti melakukan aktivitas → Contoh: She should stop to rest (berhenti untuk beristirahat).
Stop + infinitive = berhenti lalu melakukan aktivitas berbeda → Contoh: She should stop resting (berhenti beristirahat).

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Umum dengan Remember dan Forget
commonTrap.explanation: Pemula sering bingung membedakan 'remember/forget + gerund' dan 'remember/forget + infinitive'. Yang perlu diingat: gerund untuk kejadian yang SUDAH terjadi (masa lalu), infinitive untuk yang BELUM/HARUS terjadi (masa depan atau kewajiban).
commonTrap.wrong: Don't forget buying food for my packed lunch tomorrow, Mum.
commonTrap.correct: Don't forget to buy food for my packed lunch tomorrow, Mum.

dialogue.context: Empat teman (Emma, Liam, Nicole, dan Justin) sedang mengobrol di kafe. Justin terlalu sering menggunakan ponselnya saat berkumpul, dan Nicole merasa diabaikan. Justin kemudian menantang teman-temannya untuk tidak menggunakan ponsel selama akhir pekan.

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: It's been such a busy week.
lines.translation: Minggu ini sangat sibuk.

lines.speaker: Liam
lines.text: Too right. So many things to do.
lines.translation: Benar sekali. Banyak hal yang harus dilakukan.

lines.speaker: Nicole
lines.text: Same here. And all of these projects for school. It's been fun, though. Hasn't it, Justin?
lines.translation: Sama nih. Dan semua proyek untuk sekolah ini. Tapi menyenangkan, kan, Justin?

lines.speaker: Justin
lines.text: Sorry?
lines.translation: Maaf, apa?

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: Oh, come on, Justin. You're not listening to us at all.
lines.translation: Ah, ayolah, Justin. Kamu sama sekali tidak mendengarkan kami.

lines.speaker: Nicole
lines.text: You're always on your phone doing something or other.
lines.translation: Kamu selalu sibuk dengan ponselmu melakukan sesuatu.

lines.speaker: Justin
lines.text: Sorry. I know it's a bad habit, but whenever someone texts me I've just got to reply right away.
lines.translation: Maaf. Aku tahu ini kebiasaan buruk, tapi setiap kali ada yang mengirim pesan, aku harus langsung membalas.

lines.speaker: Nicole
lines.text: Seems like we're not important to you any more. You're constantly on the phone. Oh, sorry.
lines.translation: Sepertinya kami tidak penting lagi bagimu. Kamu terus-menerus bermain ponsel. Oh, maaf.

lines.speaker: Justin
lines.text: Ha! True! Hey, I challenge us all not to use our phones for the whole weekend. Not once. I bet you can't.
lines.translation: Ha! Benar! Hei, aku tantang kita semua untuk tidak menggunakan ponsel selama akhir pekan. Sama sekali tidak. Pasti kalian tidak bisa.

lines.speaker: Nicole
lines.text: Ridiculous. Of course we can. Why wouldn't we be able to?
lines.translation: Konyol. Tentu saja kami bisa. Kenapa kami tidak bisa?

lines.speaker: Emma
lines.text: Really? Oh, come on. Three days without a phone? No problem!
lines.translation: Benarkah? Ah, ayolah. Tiga hari tanpa ponsel? Tidak masalah!

lines.speaker: Justin
lines.text: OK. Let's try it, shall we? You'll never survive the weekend without your phones. You'll see. Anyone who uses their phone has to treat the others to coffee or whatever they want at the café. OK?
lines.translation: OK. Mari kita coba, ya? Kalian tidak akan bertahan akhir pekan tanpa ponsel kalian. Lihat saja. Siapa pun yang menggunakan ponsel harus mentraktir yang lain kopi atau apa pun yang mereka mau di kafe. OK?

speakingLab.context: Kamu sedang latihan percakapan dengan Mr. Khoirul tentang pengalamanmu menghadapi situasi survival atau tantangan. Mr. Khoirul akan bertanya pendapatmu tentang berbagai topik survival.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Today we're going to talk about survival situations. Have you ever been in a challenging situation where you had to keep going even when things were difficult?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, I remember climbing a mountain with my friends last year. It was really exhausting.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That sounds tough! What did you do to manage the situation? Did you feel like giving up at any point?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Actually, I wanted to stop several times, but my friends encouraged me to continue climbing. We managed to reach the summit together.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Well done! Now, imagine you're stuck with a problem and need advice. What would you try doing first?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I think I would try talking to someone about it, or maybe I'd stop thinking about it for a while and listen to some music to relax.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent strategy! One last question: is there anything you regret not doing when you were younger, or something you regret doing?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I regret not studying harder when I was in junior high school. But I don't regret spending time with my family instead.

quiz.question: Joe and Simon managed _____ the West Face of Siula Grande despite difficult conditions.
options: to climb
climbing
climb
quiz.explanation: Kata kerja 'manage' selalu diikuti oleh infinitive (to + verb). Pola: manage + to + infinitive.

quiz.question: Simon tried _____ two ropes around Joe to secure him, but the situation became hopeless.
options: to lower
lowering
lower
quiz.explanation: 'Tried lowering' berarti Simon melakukan dan melihat hasilnya (try + gerund = do it and see the results). Ini berbeda dengan 'tried to lower' yang berarti mencoba dengan susah payah.

quiz.question: I remember _____ a sandwich during a Maths class once. It was really embarrassing.
options: to eat
eating
eat
quiz.explanation: 'Remember + gerund' digunakan untuk mengingat pengalaman masa lalu. Jadi 'remember eating' artinya mengingat saat makan sandwich di kelas Maths.

quiz.question: Don't forget _____ some paper for the printer tomorrow!
options: to get
getting
get
quiz.explanation: 'Forget + infinitive' digunakan untuk jangan lupa melakukan sesuatu di masa depan. 'Don't forget to get' = jangan lupa untuk membeli.

quiz.question: When I'm with Mrs Meyer I always feel _____. It's difficult to find something to talk about with her.
options: guilty
awkward
ashamed
quiz.explanation: 'Awkward' artinya canggung atau tidak nyaman dalam situasi sosial. Ini paling sesuai dengan konteks sulit menemukan topik pembicaraan.

quiz.question: After the earthquake, the people on the island were _____ for help.
options: puzzled
desperate
stuck
quiz.explanation: 'Desperate' berarti sangat membutuhkan atau putus asa. Frasa 'desperate for help' adalah collocation yang tepat untuk situasi darurat.

modules.title: Unit 2: Going Places: Relative Clauses & Travel
modules.objective: Mampu menggunakan relative clauses (klausa relatif) dengan tepat untuk mendeskripsikan orang, tempat, dan benda, serta memahami penggunaan omitting relative pronouns dalam konteks migrasi dan perjalanan.

theory.summary: Unit ini membahas penggunaan relative clauses (klausa relatif) untuk menambahkan informasi pada kalimat. Ada dua jenis: defining relative clause (memberikan informasi esensial) dan non-defining relative clause (memberikan informasi tambahan yang tidak esensial). Kamu juga akan belajar kapan relative pronoun (who, which, that) bisa dihilangkan, yaitu ketika klausa relatif dimulai dengan relative pronoun + auxiliary verb be.
rules: Defining relative clause: Digunakan untuk mengidentifikasi which/that (benda), who/that (orang), where (tempat), whose (kepemilikan). Contoh: 'Riace is a village which is in Calabria.' (Riace adalah desa yang ada di Calabria.)

Non-defining relative clause: Memberikan informasi tambahan, dipisahkan dengan koma. Contoh: 'Riace, which is a very pretty region of Italy, had a population of 3,000.' (Riace, yang merupakan daerah cantik di Italia, memiliki populasi 3.000 jiwa.)

Which to refer to a whole clause: 'which' bisa merujuk ke seluruh klausa sebelumnya. Contoh: 'Citta Futura has 13 local employees, which makes it the biggest employer.' (Citta Futura punya 13 karyawan lokal, yang menjadikannya pemberi kerja terbesar.)

Omitting relative pronouns: Ketika relative clause dimulai dengan relative pronoun + auxiliary verb 'be', kita bisa menghilangkan keduanya. Contoh: 'I'm a student (who is) living in France.' → 'I'm a student living in France.'

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Umum: Menghilangkan Relative Pronoun yang Salah
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak pemula menghilangkan relative pronoun secara sembarangan tanpa mengecek apakah ada auxiliary verb 'be' setelahnya. Ingat: kamu hanya bisa menghilangkan relative pronoun + be, bukan relative pronoun saja.
commonTrap.wrong: I met the people come from Italy.
commonTrap.correct: I met the people who come from Italy. ATAU I met the people coming from Italy.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Manakah pernyataan yang BENAR mengenai kaidah pada topik "Relative Clauses & Travel"?
options: Tenses dan susunan subjek tidak perlu diperhatikan
Pola ini hanya boleh digunakan dalam situasi santai
Defining relative clause: Digunakan untuk mengidentifikasi which/that (benda), who/that...
readinessQuestions.explanation: Kaidah inti topik ini: Unit ini membahas penggunaan relative clauses (klausa relatif) untuk menambahkan informasi pada kalimat.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Di antara pilihan berikut, manakah kalimat yang menggunakan tata bahasa baku yang tepat?
options: I met the people come from Italy always
I met the people come from Italy
I met the people who come from Italy. ATAU I met the people coming from Italy
readinessQuestions.explanation: Banyak pemula menghilangkan relative pronoun secara sembarangan tanpa mengecek apakah ada auxiliary verb 'be' setelahnya. Ingat: kamu hanya bisa menghilangkan relative pronoun + be, bukan relative pronoun saja.

readinessQuestions.prompt:
Lengkapi dialog percakapan berikut sesuai konteks:
Karen: "Hi James, how are you doing? Hope you're OK!"
Karen: "[...]"
options: I met the people come from Italy
Sorry, I forgot my keys at home.

readinessQuestions.explanation: Respon "Well, here I am at last – living in northern Canada with the nomadic Inuit people." ("Nah, akhirnya aku di sini – tinggal di Kanada utara bersama suku Inuit yang nomaden.") adalah jawaban yang tepat dan alami sesuai alur percakapan tokoh Karen.

vocab.collocation: The village began to welcome refugees who had arrived by boat.

dialogue.context: Karen menulis email kepada temannya James tentang pengalamannya tinggal bersama suku Inuit di Kanada utara.

lines.speaker: Karen
lines.text: Hi James, how are you doing? Hope you're OK!
lines.translation: Hai James, apa kabar? Semoga kamu baik-baik saja!

lines.speaker: Karen
lines.text: Well, here I am at last – living in northern Canada with the nomadic Inuit people.
lines.translation: Nah, akhirnya aku di sini – tinggal di Kanada utara bersama suku Inuit yang nomaden.

lines.speaker: Karen
lines.text: I got here ten days ago and met a family who said I could go along with them to hunt.
lines.translation: Aku tiba di sini sepuluh hari lalu dan bertemu keluarga yang bilang aku bisa ikut berburu bersama mereka.

lines.speaker: Karen
lines.text: The most difficult thing to deal with, of course, is the cold.
lines.translation: Hal paling sulit untuk dihadapi, tentu saja, adalah cuaca dingin.

lines.speaker: Karen
lines.text: The Inuit make a hole in the ice and hope that a seal will appear so that they can catch it.
lines.translation: Orang Inuit membuat lubang di es dan berharap ada anjing laut muncul agar bisa mereka tangkap.

lines.speaker: Karen
lines.text: What amazes me most about them is their patience, and my own is getting loads better!
lines.translation: Yang paling membuatku kagum dari mereka adalah kesabaran mereka, dan kesabaranku sendiri jadi jauh lebih baik!

speakingLab.context: Kamu akan berdiskusi dengan Mr. Khoirul tentang pengalaman tinggal di luar negeri dan tantangan yang dihadapi imigran atau pengungsi.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Today we're talking about living abroad. Have you ever thought about what it would be like to live in another country? What do you think would be the most challenging part?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I think the most challenging part would be learning the language and adapting to local customs. It takes time to feel comfortable in a new culture.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's a great point. Language barriers can be tough. Now, thinking about the article we read about Riace – what do you think motivates people to welcome refugees into their communities?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I believe people like Lucano saw an opportunity to help those in need while also revitalizing their village. It shows compassion and practical thinking working together.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent observation! One last question: if you could live with a nomadic tribe for two weeks, which one would you choose and why?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I would choose the Shahsavan because I'm interested in learning about their traditional crafts and seasonal migration patterns. It would be fascinating to experience their lifestyle.

quiz.question: Which sentence correctly uses a non-defining relative clause?
options: The refugees who arrived by boat needed help.
Riace, which is in Calabria, welcomed many immigrants.
I met someone who lives in Italy.
quiz.answer: Riace, which is in Calabria, welcomed many immigrants.
quiz.explanation: Kalimat ini benar karena menggunakan koma untuk memisahkan non-defining relative clause yang memberikan informasi tambahan tentang Riace. Koma menunjukkan bahwa informasi 'which is in Calabria' bersifat tambahan, bukan esensial.

quiz.question: In which sentence can you omit 'who is'?
options: The teacher who is from France speaks three languages.
I know someone who lives in Canada.
The people who come here are very friendly.
quiz.answer: The teacher who is from France speaks three languages.
quiz.explanation: Hanya kalimat ini yang bisa menghilangkan 'who is' karena diikuti oleh 'from France' (bukan verb utama). Hasilnya: 'The teacher from France speaks three languages.' Pada dua opsi lain, 'who' diikuti langsung oleh verb utama (lives, come), jadi tidak bisa dihilangkan.

quiz.question: Which phrasal verb means 'to experience a difficult situation'?
options: hang out with
go through
pick up
quiz.explanation: 'Go through' berarti mengalami atau melewati situasi sulit. Contoh: 'It's a phase you have to go through' (Ini fase yang harus kamu lalui). 'Hang out with' berarti nongkrong bersama, sedangkan 'pick up' berarti mempelajari sesuatu dengan cepat.

quiz.question: Complete: 'The experience gained by living abroad ___ invaluable.'
options: is
are
were
quiz.explanation: Subject kalimat ini adalah 'the experience' (tunggal), jadi verb-nya menggunakan 'is'. Meskipun ada frasa 'gained by living abroad', ini hanya reduced relative clause yang memodifikasi 'experience', bukan mengubah subject menjadi jamak.

quiz.question: Which sentence uses 'which' to refer to a whole clause?
options: The village which is in Italy is very small.
Citta Futura has 13 employees, which makes it the biggest employer.
I read a book which was interesting.
quiz.answer: Citta Futura has 13 employees, which makes it the biggest employer.
quiz.explanation: Dalam kalimat ini, 'which' merujuk pada seluruh klausa sebelumnya (fakta bahwa Citta Futura punya 13 karyawan), bukan hanya kata benda tertentu. Ini menunjukkan akibat atau hasil dari informasi sebelumnya.

quiz.question: What does 'homesickness' mean?
options: feeling sick at home
missing your home and feeling sad about it
being tired of staying at home
quiz.answer: missing your home and feeling sad about it
quiz.explanation: 'Homesickness' adalah perasaan rindu rumah atau tempat asal yang membuat seseorang merasa sedih. Ini umum dialami orang yang tinggal jauh dari rumah untuk waktu lama, seperti yang disebutkan dalam blog Becca tentang tinggal di luar negeri.

modules.title: Unit 3: The Next Generation: Future Continuous & Future Perfect
modules.objective: Mampu menggunakan quantifiers untuk membahas jumlah, menggunakan so/such dan do/did untuk penekanan, serta memahami kosakata tentang kostum, seragam, dan pola asuh anak dalam konteks generasi mendatang

theory.summary: Unit ini mengajarkan cara menggunakan quantifiers (kata penentu jumlah) untuk berbicara tentang kuantitas dengan lebih presisi, serta menggunakan so/such dan do/did untuk memberikan penekanan dalam kalimat bahasa Inggris. Materi ini penting untuk berbicara tentang generasi mendatang dan pola asuh anak dengan lebih ekspresif dan akurat.
rules: Quantifiers: Gunakan 'a few/a little/some' untuk jumlah kecil, 'a lot of/lots of/plenty/much/many' untuk jumlah banyak, dan 'most/almost all/the vast majority' untuk hampir semua. Contoh: 'I've got a few followers on my blog' atau 'Most of my teachers are really nice'
So + adjective/adverb untuk penekanan: 'It was so hot that I couldn't sunbathe' atau 'He's so difficult that...'
Such + (a/an) + adjective + noun untuk penekanan: 'It was such a difficult question that I didn't know what to say' atau 'There were such interesting ideas'
Do/Does/Did untuk memberikan penekanan pada kata kerja: 'You didn't like the film, did you? I did like the film!' atau 'She does want to go'
Too + adjective/adverb = lebih dari yang dibutuhkan (makna negatif): 'too + many/much + noun'. Contoh: 'It's too hot' atau 'I have too much work'
(Not) enough = cukup/tidak cukup: 'adjective/adverb + enough' atau 'enough + noun'. Contoh: 'It's not interesting enough' atau 'I don't have enough time'

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Penggunaan So dan Such
commonTrap.explanation: Pemula sering keliru menempatkan so dan such. So diikuti langsung oleh adjective/adverb, sedangkan such diikuti oleh noun phrase (a/an + adjective + noun). Jangan sampai tertukar!
commonTrap.wrong: It was so a difficult question. / He is such intelligent.
commonTrap.correct: It was such a difficult question. / He is so intelligent.

readinessQuestions.prompt: Perhatikan jebakan umum pada materi "Future Continuous & Future Perfect". Manakah kalimat yang SUDAH TEPAT?

readinessQuestions.explanation: Pemula sering keliru menempatkan so dan such. So diikuti langsung oleh adjective/adverb, sedangkan such diikuti oleh noun phrase (a/an + adjective + noun). Jangan sampai tertukar!

Tom: "[...]"

modules.title: Unit 4: Thinking Outside the Box: Modals of Deduction & Speculation
modules.objective: Mampu menggunakan struktur 'be/get used to (doing)' vs 'used to (do)' dengan tepat, menguasai adverbs dan adverbial phrases, serta memperkaya kosakata personality adjectives dan common adverbial phrases untuk mengekspresikan frustrasi dan berpikir kreatif

theory.summary: Unit ini membahas perbedaan penting antara 'be/get used to (doing)' yang menunjukkan kebiasaan atau familiaritas dengan situasi, versus 'used to (do)' yang menjelaskan kebiasaan di masa lalu yang tidak lagi terjadi. Selain itu, unit ini mengajarkan penggunaan adverbs dan adverbial phrases untuk memperkaya ekspresi dalam bahasa Inggris, terutama dalam konteks berpikir kreatif dan menghadapi tantangan.
rules: 'used to (do)' / 'be used to (doing)' - untuk membicarakan situasi di masa lalu yang sekarang sudah berubah dan tidak benar lagi. Contoh: 'A conflict used to exist between the farmers and the lions.' (Dulu ada konflik, sekarang tidak lagi)

'be used to (do)' / 'be used to (doing)' - untuk membicarakan sesuatu yang familiar atau sudah menjadi kebiasaan. Contoh: 'The Masai are used to lions attacking their livestock.' (Mereka sudah terbiasa dengan situasi ini)

'be/get used to (doing)' / 'get used to (doing)' - untuk membicarakan proses menjadi familiar dengan sesuatu. Contoh: 'Richard used to play with things to see how they worked.' (Proses belajar dan terbiasa)

Adverbial phrases sering dibentuk dengan: 'in a/an + noun / adjective way' (in an enjoyable way), 'with/without + noun / adjective' (with enthusiasm, without difficulty). Contoh: 'I really like football, so I went to the match with interest / enthusiasm.'

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Umum: Mencampuradukkan 'used to' dengan 'be used to'
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak pemula bingung antara 'used to (do)' yang menunjukkan kebiasaan masa lalu yang sudah berhenti, dengan 'be/get used to (doing)' yang menunjukkan kebiasaan atau familiaritas saat ini. Perhatikan struktur setelah 'to': jika diikuti verb dasar, gunakan 'used to'. Jika diikuti gerund (verb-ing) atau noun, gunakan 'be/get used to'.
commonTrap.wrong: I used to wake up early, but now I'm used to wake up late.
commonTrap.correct: I used to wake up early, but now I'm used to waking up late.

modules.title: Unit 5: Screen Time: Conditionals with Conjunctions & Technology
modules.objective: Mampu menggunakan struktur obligation, permission, dan prohibition untuk memberikan nasihat; menguasai bentuk necessity (didn't need to/needn't have); serta mengekspresikan ability in the past (could, was/were able to, managed to, succeeded in) dalam konteks teknologi dan screen time.

theory.summary: Unit ini membahas tiga area gramatikal penting: (1) Obligation, permission, dan prohibition menggunakan have to, must, should, need to, dan be allowed to untuk memberikan nasihat dan aturan; (2) Necessity dengan didn't need to (tidak perlu melakukan sesuatu dan memang tidak dilakukan) vs needn't have done (tidak perlu melakukan tapi tetap dilakukan); (3) Ability in the past menggunakan could, was/were able to, managed to, dan succeeded in untuk menyatakan kemampuan umum atau pencapaian spesifik di masa lalu. Semua konsep ini diterapkan dalam konteks teknologi dan penggunaan layar.
rules: Obligation/Necessity: have to/must + infinitive (Most experts agree that screen time should be limited). Permission: be allowed to + infinitive. Prohibition: be not allowed to (Children aren't allowed to look at screens all the time).

Necessity: didn't need to + infinitive = tidak perlu dan tidak dilakukan (I didn't need to go to the stadium because I was able to watch it online). needn't have + past participle = tidak perlu tapi tetap dilakukan (You needn't have bought two tickets because I already had them).

Ability in the past - general: could/couldn't + infinitive (Many people couldn't even switch on a computer). Ability - specific achievement: was/were able to, managed to, succeeded in + gerund/noun (She managed to create a YouTube tutorial; He succeeded in making a rap video).
Had better = memberikan saran/peringatan, selalu diikuti base form verb (You had better turn off the TV if you don't want to get a headache).

Be supposed to = ada kewajiban/ekspektasi untuk melakukan sesuatu, tapi pada kenyataannya orang tidak selalu melakukannya. Selalu dalam bentuk passive (We're supposed to answer our phones whether we're at work, at home, or even asleep).

commonTrap.explanation: Pemula sering salah menggunakan couldn't untuk menyatakan ketidakmampuan dalam situasi spesifik yang berhasil diatasi. Couldn't digunakan untuk kemampuan umum atau kegagalan, sedangkan was/were able to, managed to, atau succeeded in digunakan untuk pencapaian spesifik di masa lalu.

modules.title: Unit 6: Bringing People Together: Gerunds, Infinitives & Community
modules.objective: Mampu menggunakan comparatives dengan intensifier, memahami linkers of contrast, dan menggunakan vocabulary tentang hubungan interpersonal serta cara berbicara yang natural dalam konteks komunitas dan amal.

theory.summary: Unit ini fokus pada penggunaan comparatives yang lebih kuat dengan intensifier seperti 'a lot', 'far', 'much', serta linkers of contrast seperti 'although', 'despite', 'however', dan 'nevertheless'. Kamu juga akan belajar vocabulary tentang hubungan (fall in love, get engaged, split up) dan cara menggunakan exaggeration dalam berbicara.
rules: Intensifying Comparatives: Gunakan 'a lot/far/much + comparative' untuk memperkuat perbandingan. Contoh: 'The train was far more crowded than I expected.'
Use 'just as/not nearly as + adjective + as' untuk perbandingan yang lebih dekat atau berbeda jauh. Contoh: 'My teachers were just as strict then as they are now.'
Use 'the + comparative, the + comparative' untuk menunjukkan hubungan sebab-akibat. Contoh: 'The longer the train stood still, the more annoyed people became.'

Linkers of Contrast: 'Although/Even though' diikuti klausa penuh. 'Despite/In spite of' diikuti noun phrase. 'However/Nevertheless' memperkenalkan kalimat kontras baru. Contoh: 'Despite its popularity, many people didn't know where the idea had come from.'
Love Relationship Phrases: 'to fall in love (with)', 'to get engaged (to)', 'to split up (with)', 'to get married (to)', 'to go out (together)', dll.

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Umum: Despite vs Although
commonTrap.explanation: Pemula sering bingung antara 'despite' dan 'although'. 'Despite' harus diikuti noun atau gerund, sedangkan 'although' diikuti subjek + verb (klausa lengkap).
commonTrap.wrong: Despite he was tired, he kept working.
commonTrap.correct: Despite being tired, he kept working. / Although he was tired, he kept working.

modules.title: Unit 7: Always Look on the Bright Side: Ways of Referring to Future & Optimism
modules.objective: Mampu menggunakan berbagai bentuk future tense (future continuous, future perfect) untuk membicarakan rencana dan prediksi masa depan, serta mengekspresikan optimisme dan perasaan terhadap kejadian mendatang dengan natural.

theory.summary: Unit ini membahas cara-cara merujuk ke masa depan dalam bahasa Inggris, khususnya future continuous dan future perfect. Kalian akan belajar kapan menggunakan 'be about to', 'be off to', dan 'be on the point of' untuk situasi yang berbeda. Selain itu, unit ini mengajarkan cara mengekspresikan optimisme dan perasaan tentang kejadian masa depan dengan vocabulary yang kaya.
rules: Future Continuous: will + be + verb-ing. Digunakan untuk aksi yang sedang berlangsung di waktu tertentu di masa depan. Contoh: 'On Tuesday afternoon my friends will be playing football.' / 'I'll be sitting in the new ice cream shop near school.'

Future Perfect: will + have + past participle. Digunakan untuk aksi yang akan selesai sebelum waktu tertentu di masa depan. Sering digunakan dengan 'by' (by then, by the time). Contoh: 'By the time the plane leaves London, a lot of snow will have fallen on our ski resort.' / 'Anna will still be shopping and she'll have missed her flight.'
Be about to + infinitive: untuk sesuatu yang akan segera terjadi. Contoh: 'He's about to attack me.'
Be off to + infinitive/noun: untuk rencana perjalanan atau kepergian. Contoh: 'I'm off to Spain on Tuesday.'
Be on the point of + verb-ing: untuk sesuatu yang akan terjadi dalam waktu sangat dekat. Contoh: 'I'm on the point of doing this right now.'

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Penggunaan Future Simple vs Future Continuous
commonTrap.explanation: Pemula sering menggunakan future simple (will + verb) padahal konteksnya membutuhkan future continuous untuk menunjukkan aksi yang sedang berlangsung di waktu tertentu di masa depan. Future continuous memberi nuansa bahwa aksi tersebut sedang dalam proses, bukan hanya akan terjadi.
commonTrap.wrong: At 3 PM tomorrow, I will finish my homework.
commonTrap.correct: At 3 PM tomorrow, I will be finishing my homework.

modules.title: Unit 8: Making Lists: Participle Clauses & Organization
modules.objective: Mampu menggunakan conditional sentences (zero, first, second, third, dan mixed conditionals) dengan tepat, memahami phrasal verbs tingkat lanjut, serta menggunakan alternatif kata hubung seperti suppose, provided, as long as, otherwise, dan unless dalam konteks formal dan informal.

theory.summary: Unit ini berfokus pada penggunaan kalimat bersyarat (conditionals) dalam berbagai tipe, termasuk mixed conditionals yang menggabungkan waktu berbeda. Kamu juga akan mempelajari cara menggunakan alternatif 'if' seperti suppose, provided, as long as, otherwise, dan unless untuk menyatakan syarat dengan lebih bervariasi. Selain itu, unit ini memperkenalkan phrasal verbs tingkat lanjut yang sering digunakan dalam konteks profesional dan akademik.
rules: Zero Conditional: If + present simple, present simple. Contoh: If surgeons run through a simple checklist before every operation, then lives will be saved.
First Conditional: If + present simple, will + infinitive. Contoh: If you take this medicine, you won't get headaches.
Second Conditional: If + past simple, would(n't) + infinitive. Contoh: If I had surgery, I'd want the surgeon to use this list.
Third Conditional: If + past perfect, would(n't) have + past participle. Contoh: If I had read books, I would have learned things about life.
Mixed Conditionals: Menggabungkan kondisi masa lalu dengan hasil masa sekarang atau sebaliknya. Contoh: If I hadn't studied yesterday, I wouldn't be ready now.

Alternatives to 'if': suppose (mengandaikan), provided/as long as (dengan syarat), unless (kecuali jika), otherwise (jika tidak). Contoh: You can go to the party, provided you promise to be home by 11 o'clock.

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Umum: Mencampur Tenses dalam Conditionals
commonTrap.explanation: Pemula sering mencampur struktur conditional yang berbeda atau menggunakan 'will' di klausa 'if'. Ingat, setiap tipe conditional memiliki pola tenses yang tetap dan tidak boleh dicampur sembarangan kecuali dalam mixed conditionals yang memang dirancang untuk menghubungkan waktu berbeda.
commonTrap.wrong: If you will take this medicine, you won't get headaches.
commonTrap.correct: If you take this medicine, you won't get headaches.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul

quiz.question: Which conditional sentence is correct?
options: If surgeons will run through a checklist, lives will be saved.
If surgeons run through a checklist, lives will be saved.
If surgeons would run through a checklist, lives are saved.
quiz.answer: If surgeons run through a checklist, lives will be saved.
quiz.explanation: Ini adalah first conditional yang menggunakan pola: If + present simple, will + infinitive. Jangan gunakan 'will' di klausa 'if'.

quiz.question: Complete: 'If I had taken this medicine earlier, I _____ got headaches.'
options: wouldn't have
won't have
wouldn't
quiz.explanation: Ini adalah third conditional (past unreal) yang menggunakan pola: If + past perfect, would(n't) have + past participle.

quiz.question: Which word means 'dengan syarat bahwa'?
options: otherwise
provided
unless
quiz.explanation: 'Provided' atau 'as long as' digunakan untuk menyatakan syarat atau kondisi yang harus dipenuhi.

quiz.question: Choose the correct mixed conditional: 'If I hadn't studied yesterday, I _____ ready now.'
options: wouldn't be
wouldn't have been
won't be
quiz.explanation: Mixed conditional menghubungkan kondisi masa lalu (past perfect di klausa 'if') dengan hasil masa sekarang (would + infinitive di main clause).

quiz.question: What does the phrasal verb 'point out' mean?
options: menunjukkan atau menegaskan sesuatu
menghilangkan sesuatu
mengatur sesuatu
quiz.explanation: 'Point out' berarti menunjukkan, menegaskan, atau menarik perhatian pada sesuatu yang penting.

quiz.question: Complete with the correct alternative to 'if': 'You can borrow my phone _____ you don't make any long calls on it.'
options: unless
as long as
otherwise
quiz.explanation: 'As long as' atau 'provided' digunakan untuk menyatakan syarat yang harus dipenuhi agar sesuatu dapat terjadi.

modules.title: Unit 9: Be Your Own Life Coach: Mixed Conditionals & Personal Growth
modules.objective: Mampu menggunakan mixed conditionals (I wish, If only, I would prefer, I'd rather, It's time) untuk mengekspresikan keinginan, penyesalan, dan preferensi dalam konteks pengembangan diri dan kehidupan sehari-hari

theory.summary: Unit ini mengajarkan penggunaan mixed conditionals untuk mengekspresikan penyesalan masa lalu dan keinginan tentang situasi saat ini atau masa depan. Fokus utama adalah pada struktur I wish, If only, I would prefer, I'd rather, dan It's time yang sering digunakan dalam memberikan saran dan berbicara tentang pertumbuhan pribadi.
rules: I wish / If only + past simple: untuk penyesalan tentang situasi sekarang. Contoh: 'I wish I could disappear' (Saya berharap saya bisa menghilang)
I wish / If only + past perfect: untuk penyesalan tentang masa lalu. Contoh: 'If only I had studied harder for that test' (Andai saja saya belajar lebih keras untuk ujian itu)
I'd rather + base form: untuk preferensi umum. Contoh: 'I'd rather go to the park' (Saya lebih suka pergi ke taman)
I'd rather + subject + past tense: ketika subjek kalimat kedua berbeda. Contoh: 'I'd rather you didn't practise right now' (Saya lebih suka kamu tidak berlatih sekarang)
I'd sooner + base form: alternatif dari I'd rather. Contoh: 'I'd sooner go to the park and play football for real' (Saya lebih suka pergi ke taman dan bermain sepak bola sungguhan)
I would prefer + to + infinitive: untuk preferensi formal. Contoh: 'I would prefer to take a taxi' (Saya lebih memilih naik taksi)
It's time / It's about time + past simple: untuk menyatakan sesuatu seharusnya sudah dilakukan. Contoh: 'It's about time you got out of bed' (Sudah waktunya kamu bangun dari tempat tidur)

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Umum: Tense Setelah I wish dan If only
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak pemula salah menggunakan tense setelah I wish dan If only. Untuk situasi sekarang, gunakan past simple (bukan present). Untuk situasi masa lalu, gunakan past perfect (bukan past simple).
commonTrap.wrong: I wish I can disappear. / If only my teacher understands me.
commonTrap.correct: I wish I could disappear. / If only my teacher understood me.

dialogue.context: Josh dan ibunya sedang makan malam bersama, dan ibunya meminta Josh untuk tidak menggunakan ponselnya di meja makan dengan cara yang sopan.

speakingLab.context: Anda sedang berkonsultasi dengan Mr. Khoirul tentang masalah yang Anda hadapi dalam kehidupan sehari-hari. Mr. Khoirul akan membantu Anda mengekspresikan penyesalan dan preferensi menggunakan mixed conditionals.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I wish I had more time to study. I'm always so busy with other things.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul

quiz.question: Complete the sentence: If only my teacher _____ me. He wouldn't be so angry with me now.
options: understands
understood
had understood
quiz.explanation: Karena ini adalah penyesalan tentang masa lalu yang berdampak pada masa kini (mixed conditional), kita menggunakan past perfect setelah 'If only'. Situasinya: guru tidak memahami di masa lalu, dan sekarang dia marah.

quiz.question: Choose the correct option: I _____ you didn't practise right now. I'm so tired.
options: wish
rather
'd rather
quiz.explanation: Ketika subjek kalimat pertama dan kedua berbeda ('I' dan 'you'), kita menggunakan 'I'd rather + subject + past tense' untuk mengekspresikan preferensi. Bentuk lengkapnya adalah 'I'd rather you didn't practise'.

quiz.question: Which sentence expresses regret about the past correctly?
options: I wish I study harder for that test.
I wish I studied harder for that test.
I wish I had studied harder for that test.
quiz.answer: I wish I had studied harder for that test.
quiz.explanation: Untuk penyesalan tentang masa lalu, kita menggunakan 'I wish + past perfect'. Past perfect menunjukkan bahwa kejadian tersebut sudah terjadi dan tidak bisa diubah lagi.

quiz.question: Complete: It's about time you _____ out of bed and did something!
options: get
got
have got
quiz.explanation: Setelah 'It's time' atau 'It's about time', kita menggunakan past simple untuk menyatakan bahwa sesuatu seharusnya sudah dilakukan sekarang. Ini adalah struktur khusus yang menggunakan past tense untuk situasi present.

quiz.question: Which expression means 'to think about something negative for a long time'?
options: to dwell on something
to let someone down
to get in the way of something
quiz.explanation: 'To dwell on something' berarti terus memikirkan sesuatu (biasanya hal negatif atau masalah) dalam waktu yang lama. Seperti dalam nasihat: 'Don't dwell on the past.'

quiz.question: Choose the correct sentence using 'I'd prefer':
options: I'd prefer if you don't tell anyone else.
I'd prefer it if you didn't tell anyone else.
I'd prefer you don't tell anyone else.
quiz.answer: I'd prefer it if you didn't tell anyone else.
quiz.explanation: Ketika menggunakan 'I'd prefer' dengan subjek yang berbeda, struktur yang benar adalah 'I'd prefer it if + subject + past tense'. Kata 'it' diperlukan dalam struktur ini.

modules.title: Unit 10: Spreading the News: Passive Report Structures & Media
modules.objective: Mampu menggunakan struktur pasif dalam pelaporan berita (reported speech, reported questions), memahami cara berbagi informasi di media sosial dan tradisional, serta menganalisis etika jurnalisme

theory.summary: Unit ini mengajarkan cara melaporkan pernyataan dan pertanyaan orang lain menggunakan struktur reported speech dan reported questions. Kamu akan belajar mengubah tenses, kata ganti, dan ekspresi waktu saat melaporkan ucapan seseorang. Unit ini juga membahas kosakata seputar berbagi berita, verb patterns untuk reporting verbs, dan etika jurnalisme.
rules: Reported Speech (statements): Ubah tenses mundur satu tingkat. Contoh: She said, 'I am happy' → She said (that) she was happy. Present simple → past simple, present continuous → past continuous, present perfect → past perfect, past simple → past perfect, will → would, can → could.

Reported Questions: Gunakan if/whether untuk yes/no questions dan kata tanya untuk wh-questions. Urutan kata seperti statement (subjek + verb), tanpa auxiliary do/does/did. Contoh: 'Where are you going?' → He asked me where I was going. 'Do you like it?' → She asked me if/whether I liked it.
Reported Requests: Gunakan asked + person + to + infinitive. Contoh: 'Can you help me?' → He asked me to help him.
Time expressions juga berubah: now → then, today → that day, tomorrow → the next day/the following day, yesterday → the day before/the previous day, here → there, this → that.

Reporting verbs memiliki pola berbeda: accuse + person + of + gerund (She accused him of lying), admit/deny + gerund (He admitted taking it), apologise + for + gerund (He apologised for being late), warn + person + to + infinitive (She warned me to be careful), agree/regret + to + infinitive (He agreed to help).

commonTrap.trapTitle: Lupa Mengubah Tenses dan Ekspresi Waktu
commonTrap.explanation: Kesalahan umum adalah lupa mengubah tenses atau ekspresi waktu saat melaporkan ucapan. Pemula sering menggunakan tenses yang sama seperti direct speech, atau lupa mengubah 'today' menjadi 'that day', 'tomorrow' menjadi 'the next day', dsb.
commonTrap.wrong: She said she is busy today and will come tomorrow.
commonTrap.correct: She said she was busy that day and would come the next day.

dialogue.context: Nicole menjelaskan kepada teman-temannya mengapa dia terlambat ke bus. Dia akan muncul di televisi untuk wawancara berita.

speakingLab.context: Anda sedang berlatih melaporkan berita dan berbicara tentang cara berbagi informasi. Mr. Khoirul akan menanyakan pendapat Anda tentang media sosial dan berbagi berita.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: What's the most reliable way to get accurate news? Give reasons why you often do you use that source.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I think traditional news websites from established newspapers are the most reliable because they have professional journalists who verify facts before publishing.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's a good point. Now, do you always believe what people tweet? How do you verify important information that comes to you via social media?

turns.speaker: You

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul

quiz.question: She said, 'I will call you tomorrow.' Bentuk reported speech yang benar adalah:
options: She said she will call me tomorrow.
She said she would call me the next day.
She said she would call me tomorrow.
quiz.answer: She said she would call me the next day.
quiz.explanation: Dalam reported speech, 'will' berubah menjadi 'would' dan 'tomorrow' berubah menjadi 'the next day' atau 'the following day'.

quiz.question: 'Where are you going?' he asked. Bentuk reported question yang tepat:
options: He asked where was I going.
He asked where I was going.
He asked where am I going.
quiz.answer: He asked where I was going.
quiz.explanation: Reported questions menggunakan urutan kata statement (subject + verb), bukan question order. Tenses juga berubah dari present continuous menjadi past continuous.

quiz.question: Frasa yang tepat untuk 'menghubungi seseorang' adalah:
options: get in touch with someone
break the news to someone
drop someone the line
quiz.explanation: 'Get in touch with someone' berarti menghubungi atau berkomunikasi dengan seseorang. 'Break the news' berarti menyampaikan berita (biasanya buruk), dan yang benar adalah 'drop someone A line' bukan 'the line'.

quiz.question: Pola yang benar untuk verb 'accused' dalam reported speech adalah:
options: accused + person + to + infinitive
accused + person + of + gerund
accused + that clause
quiz.explanation: Verb 'accuse' diikuti oleh person + of + gerund. Contoh: She accused him of stealing the money.

quiz.question: 'Can you help me?' she asked. Bentuk reported request yang benar:
options: She asked me if I can help her.
She asked me to help her.
She asked me that I help her.
quiz.answer: She asked me to help her.
quiz.explanation: Untuk reported requests, gunakan pola: asked + person + to + infinitive. Ini berbeda dengan reported questions.

quiz.question: Manakah yang BUKAN termasuk cara berbagi berita di media sosial menurut artikel?
options: Posting news the second it happens
Connecting with people who care about the same things
Writing formal letters to newspapers
quiz.explanation: Artikel membahas cara berbagi berita melalui Twitter/media sosial seperti posting langsung, retweeting, dan menghubungkan orang dengan interest yang sama. Menulis surat formal ke koran adalah cara tradisional, bukan cara media sosial.

modules.title: Unit 11: Space and Beyond: Inversion with Negative Adverbials & Science
modules.objective: Mampu berspekulasi tentang masa lalu, sekarang, dan masa depan menggunakan modal verbs; menggunakan cause and effect linkers dengan tepat; memahami dan menggunakan idiom tentang ruang angkasa; serta mengidentifikasi argumen yang cacat dalam diskusi ilmiah.

theory.summary: Unit ini mengajarkan cara berspekulasi (speculating) menggunakan modal verbs untuk kejadian masa lalu, sekarang, dan masa depan. Kamu juga akan belajar menggunakan cause and effect linkers seperti 'due to', 'as a result of', dan 'consequently' untuk menunjukkan hubungan sebab-akibat dalam kalimat kompleks. Materi ini sangat berguna untuk diskusi ilmiah dan analisis situasi.
rules: Untuk spekulasi kemungkinan masa lalu: might have + past participle, may have + past participle, could have + past participle. Contoh: 'They might have visited us' (Mereka mungkin sudah mengunjungi kita).
Untuk spekulasi kepastian masa lalu: must have + past participle (positif), can't have + past participle (negatif). Contoh: 'They must have got lost' (Mereka pasti tersesat).
Untuk spekulasi masa sekarang/masa depan: might be, may be, could be (kemungkinan); must be (kepastian); can't be (mustahil). Contoh: 'Jim's certain to know' (Jim pasti tahu).

Cause and effect linkers: 'due to' dan 'as a result of' diikuti oleh noun phrase, biasanya di awal atau tengah kalimat. Contoh: 'Due to the accident, the astronaut finds himself stranded' (Karena kecelakaan tersebut, astronot itu terperangkap).

Linker 'consequently' umumnya muncul di awal kalimat baru untuk memperkenalkan efek/akibat dari sebab yang disebutkan sebelumnya. Contoh: 'The paste came out everywhere. Consequently, wasabi was put on a list of forbidden space foods' (Pastanya keluar kemana-mana. Akibatnya, wasabi dimasukkan dalam daftar makanan terlarang di luar angkasa).

speakingLab.context: Kamu sedang berdiskusi dengan Mr. Khoirul tentang kemungkinan kehidupan di luar angkasa dan teknologi alien. Gunakan modal verbs untuk berspekulasi.

quiz.question: Choose the correct sentence with a cause and effect linker:

Consequently of the incident, wasabi was forbidden.
The wasabi was forbidden consequently the incident.
quiz.answer: Consequently, wasabi was put on a list of forbidden space foods.
quiz.explanation: 'Consequently' digunakan di awal kalimat baru (biasanya setelah titik) untuk memperkenalkan akibat dari sebab yang disebutkan di kalimat sebelumnya. Tidak diikuti 'of' dan tidak diletakkan di tengah tanpa koma.

modules.title: Unit 12: More to Explore: Emphatic Structures, Cleft Sentences & Discovery
modules.objective: Mampu menggunakan passive report structures dan passive dengan dua objek untuk menyampaikan informasi secara formal dan persuasif, serta menguasai kosakata geografis dan kolokasi verb + noun

theory.summary: Unit ini mengajarkan passive report structures yang sering digunakan dalam bahasa formal dan akademik untuk melaporkan kepercayaan, pengetahuan, atau pendapat. Struktur ini membuat kalimat lebih objektif dan impersonal. Selain itu, unit ini juga membahas passive voice dengan dua objek (direct dan indirect object).
rules: Passive report structure: It + be + past participle + that clause. Contoh: It is thought that thousands of caves exist in China.
Passive report dengan to + infinitive untuk beliefs/knowledge tentang people/things. Contoh: She is said to be one of the greatest explorers of all time.
Passive report dengan to + have + past participle untuk beliefs/knowledge tentang actions. Contoh: Many people are known to have died on the expedition.
Passive dengan dua objek - Verb + indirect object + direct object: The teacher read the children a story. Menjadi passivenya: The children were read a story ATAU A story was read to the children.
Untuk passive dengan dua objek, lebih umum menggunakan person sebagai subject dari passive construction, bukan object.

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Umum: Memilih Subject yang Salah dalam Passive dengan Dua Objek
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak pelajar salah memilih subject saat membuat passive dari kalimat dengan dua objek. Meskipun secara gramatikal kedua bentuk benar, dalam bahasa Inggris natural lebih umum menggunakan person (indirect object) sebagai subject, bukan thing (direct object).

commonTrap.correct: She was paid a lot of money.

quiz.question: Which sentence correctly uses a passive report structure?

quiz.explanation: Passive report structure menggunakan pola: It + be + past participle + that clause. Pilihan pertama adalah active voice, pilihan ketiga salah karena 'it believes' tidak gramatikal.

quiz.explanation: Untuk passive report tentang beliefs/knowledge, kita gunakan: subject + be + past participle + to + infinitive. 'Death Valley is known to be' adalah struktur yang benar.

modules.title: Ujian Kelulusan C1.1: Evaluasi Komprehensif Advanced Foundations
modules.objective: Ujian kelulusan komprehensif 4 keterampilan (Listening, Reading, Writing, Speaking) untuk membuka Sub-Level C1.2

theory.summary: Ujian kelulusan C1.1 ini mengevaluasi kemampuan komprehensif Anda dalam empat keterampilan bahasa Inggris pada tingkat mahir: mendengarkan transkrip akademis kompleks, membaca artikel saintifik dan sastra, menulis dengan presisi sintaksis tingkat lanjut, dan berbicara dengan argumentasi diplomatik. Ujian ini mencakup penguasaan struktur gramatikal canggih seperti gerunds vs infinitives dalam konteks formal, relative clauses untuk elaborasi kompleks, future tenses untuk prediksi dan proyeksi akademis, modals of deduction untuk inferensi logis, participle clauses untuk ekonomi bahasa, dan emphatic structures untuk retorika persuasif. Setiap bagian dirancang untuk menguji kemampuan Anda menerapkan pengetahuan linguistik dalam konteks profesional dan akademis yang autentik.
rules: Gerunds and Infinitives: Gunakan gerund (-ing) setelah preposisi dan verb tertentu (avoid, consider, suggest), gunakan infinitive (to + verb) setelah adjective dan verb tertentu (decide, plan, manage). Pattern: 'He succeeded in completing' vs 'He managed to complete'.

Relative Clauses: Gunakan defining relative clauses tanpa koma untuk informasi esensial, non-defining dengan koma untuk informasi tambahan. Gunakan 'which' untuk merujuk seluruh klausa sebelumnya. Pattern: 'The research, which took five years, revealed...'

Modals of Deduction: Gunakan 'must have + past participle' untuk kesimpulan logis masa lalu, 'might/could have' untuk kemungkinan, 'can't have' untuk impossibility. Pattern: 'She must have forgotten the deadline' (deduksi kuat).

Participle Clauses: Gunakan present participle untuk aksi simultan atau sebab-akibat, past participle untuk passive voice. Pattern: 'Having completed the analysis, the team presented their findings' (ekonomi bahasa).

Emphatic Structures: Gunakan cleft sentences untuk penekanan: 'It was the methodology that impressed the reviewers' atau 'What matters most is the implementation'. Gunakan inversion setelah negative adverbials: 'Not only did they succeed, but they also exceeded expectations'.

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Umum dalam Struktur Kompleks Tingkat C1
commonTrap.explanation: Pelajar tingkat C1 sering mencampuradukkan penggunaan gerund dan infinitive setelah verb tertentu, salah menempatkan koma dalam relative clauses sehingga mengubah makna, atau menggunakan modal deduction yang tidak sesuai dengan tingkat kepastian yang dimaksud. Kesalahan lain termasuk participle clauses yang dangling (tidak jelas subjeknya) dan emphatic structures yang terlalu berlebihan sehingga mengurangi profesionalitas.

dialogue.context: Dua peneliti senior, Dr. Rahman dan Dr. Chen, sedang mendiskusikan hasil penelitian interdisipliner mereka mengenai dampak teknologi AI terhadap metodologi riset akademis di ruang konferensi universitas.

lines.speaker: Dr. Rahman
lines.text: Having reviewed the preliminary data, I must say the findings are rather more nuanced than we initially anticipated.
lines.translation: Setelah meninjau data awal, saya harus mengatakan bahwa temuan ini jauh lebih bernuansa daripada yang awalnya kami perkirakan.

lines.speaker: Dr. Chen
lines.text: Indeed. What strikes me most is the extent to which AI-driven methodologies can both enhance and potentially compromise research integrity.
lines.translation: Memang benar. Yang paling mencolok bagi saya adalah sejauh mana metodologi berbasis AI dapat meningkatkan sekaligus berpotensi mengkompromikan integritas riset.

lines.speaker: Dr. Rahman
lines.text: Precisely. Not only do we need to substantiate these claims with more rigorous empirical evidence, but we also must address the ethical implications.
lines.translation: Tepat sekali. Kita tidak hanya perlu membuktikan klaim ini dengan bukti empiris yang lebih ketat, tetapi kita juga harus membahas implikasi etisnya.

lines.speaker: Dr. Chen
lines.text: I couldn't agree more. The paradigm shift we're witnessing necessitates a complete re-evaluation of our peer review processes.
lines.translation: Saya sangat setuju. Pergeseran paradigma yang kita saksikan memerlukan evaluasi ulang menyeluruh terhadap proses peer review kita.

lines.speaker: Dr. Rahman
lines.text: That being said, we should avoid exacerbating existing concerns among traditionalists who might resist any technological integration.
lines.translation: Meskipun demikian, kita harus menghindari memperburuk kekhawatiran yang ada di kalangan tradisionalis yang mungkin menolak integrasi teknologi apa pun.

lines.speaker: Dr. Chen
lines.text: A pragmatic approach would be to pilot these methodologies in controlled environments before broader implementation.
lines.translation: Pendekatan pragmatis adalah menguji coba metodologi ini di lingkungan terkontrol sebelum implementasi yang lebih luas.

lines.speaker: Dr. Rahman
lines.text: Absolutely. Were we to implement these changes precipitously, we might inadvertently preclude valuable insights from emerging organically.
lines.translation: Benar sekali. Jika kita menerapkan perubahan ini secara tergesa-gesa, kita mungkin secara tidak sengaja menghalangi wawasan berharga yang muncul secara organik.

lines.speaker: Dr. Chen
lines.text: Which is precisely why establishing clear protocols that are conducive to both innovation and academic rigor remains paramount.
lines.translation: Itulah mengapa menetapkan protokol yang jelas yang mendukung inovasi dan ketelitian akademis tetap menjadi hal yang terpenting.

speakingLab.context: Anda sedang mengikuti sesi konsultasi akhir dengan Mr. Khoirul sebelum ujian komprehensif C1.1. Beliau akan menguji kemampuan Anda dalam mengartikulasikan argumen kompleks dan merespons pertanyaan kritis dengan diplomasi.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Good afternoon. Before we commence the comprehensive examination, I'd like to assess your readiness. Could you articulate what you consider to be the most challenging aspect of C1-level English proficiency?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Good afternoon, Mr. Khoirul. I believe the most challenging aspect is maintaining nuanced precision across all four skills simultaneously while adapting register appropriately to various professional contexts.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: An insightful observation. Now, having studied the advanced structures we've covered, how might you respond to criticism that your academic writing lacks sufficient hedging?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: That's a valid concern. I would acknowledge that academic discourse necessitates cautious claims. I've been working on incorporating more tentative language such as 'the data suggests' rather than 'the data proves' to mitigate overgeneralization.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent. Let me pose a more challenging scenario: Suppose you're presenting research findings to a skeptical audience. How would you substantiate your conclusions while addressing potential counterarguments?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I would begin by acknowledging the limitations inherent in any research methodology, then present corroborating evidence from multiple independent sources. Not only would this demonstrate methodological rigor, but it would also preemptively address concerns about bias.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Very diplomatic indeed. One final question: What strategies do you employ to avoid the common trap of dangling participles when constructing complex sentences?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I ensure that the subject of the participle clause matches the subject of the main clause. For instance, rather than saying 'Having completed the analysis, the results were surprising,' I would say 'Having completed the analysis, we found the results surprising.'

quiz.question: [Listening Comprehension] Audio Transcript: 'The implications of climate change on agricultural productivity cannot be overstated. Recent studies suggest that, were current trends to continue unabated, we might witness a 30% reduction in crop yields by 2050. What researchers find particularly concerning is not merely the magnitude of this decline, but rather the rapidity with which these changes are manifesting.' Based on this academic lecture excerpt, what is the speaker's primary concern?
options: The exact percentage of crop yield reduction
The speed at which agricultural changes are occurring
The methodology used in recent climate studies
The geographic distribution of affected regions
quiz.answer: The speed at which agricultural changes are occurring
quiz.explanation: Speaker menyatakan 'What researchers find particularly concerning is not merely the magnitude... but rather the rapidity' yang menunjukkan bahwa kecepatan perubahan adalah kekhawatiran utama, bukan hanya besaran penurunannya. Ini adalah contoh listening comprehension tingkat C1 yang menguji kemampuan mengidentifikasi main idea dari pernyataan kompleks dengan struktur emphatic.

quiz.question: [Listening Comprehension] Audio Transcript: 'Dr. Sharma must have dedicated countless hours to this project, given the meticulous attention to detail evident throughout the manuscript. The thoroughness with which she addressed every potential counterargument suggests an extraordinary level of scholarly commitment.' What does the speaker deduce about Dr. Sharma?
options: She has written many manuscripts before
She invested significant time and effort in the project
She received assistance from multiple researchers
She specializes in addressing counterarguments
quiz.answer: She invested significant time and effort in the project
quiz.explanation: Penggunaan 'must have dedicated countless hours' adalah modal of deduction yang menunjukkan kesimpulan logis kuat tentang dedikasi waktu Dr. Sharma. Ini menguji pemahaman tentang modal deduction dalam konteks akademis dan kemampuan mengidentifikasi inferensi yang dibuat pembicara.

quiz.question: [Listening Comprehension] Audio Transcript: 'The committee, having deliberated for several weeks, ultimately decided against implementing the proposed changes. What proved decisive was not the financial considerations, which were substantial, but rather concerns about stakeholder engagement.' What grammatical structure introduces the reason for the committee's decision?
options: A participle clause showing completed action
A relative clause providing additional information
An emphatic cleft sentence highlighting the key factor
A conditional clause suggesting hypothetical outcomes
quiz.answer: An emphatic cleft sentence highlighting the key factor
quiz.explanation: Struktur 'What proved decisive was...' adalah cleft sentence yang digunakan untuk memberikan penekanan pada alasan utama keputusan. Ini menguji kemampuan mengidentifikasi emphatic structures dalam listening dan memahami fungsi retorikanya dalam discourse akademis.

quiz.question: [Listening Comprehension] Audio Transcript: 'Not only did the intervention succeed in reducing costs, but it also enhanced overall patient satisfaction scores significantly. The dual benefit, which had not been anticipated by the initial projections, represents a paradigm shift in healthcare delivery models.' What does the speaker emphasize through inversion?
options: The unexpected nature of dual benefits
The magnitude of both cost reduction and satisfaction improvement
The inadequacy of initial projections
The innovative nature of healthcare models
quiz.answer: The magnitude of both cost reduction and satisfaction improvement
quiz.explanation: Penggunaan inversion 'Not only did... but also' adalah emphatic structure yang menekankan pencapaian ganda. Ini menguji pemahaman tentang bagaimana negative inversion digunakan untuk memberikan penekanan retoris pada hasil positif dalam konteks profesional.

quiz.question: [Reading Comprehension] Passage: 'The proliferation of artificial intelligence in academic research presents a paradox. While AI-driven analytical tools have undeniably enhanced our capacity to process vast datasets, they simultaneously threaten to homogenize research methodologies, potentially stifling the creative intuition that has historically driven breakthrough discoveries. The challenge, therefore, lies not in resisting technological integration, but rather in cultivating an epistemological framework that preserves human agency within increasingly automated research environments.' The author's primary argument is that:
options: Artificial intelligence should be excluded from academic research
Technology inevitably compromises research creativity
Researchers must balance AI efficiency with human creativity
Automated systems produce more reliable research outcomes
quiz.answer: Researchers must balance AI efficiency with human creativity
quiz.explanation: Penulis menyatakan 'The challenge... lies not in resisting... but rather in cultivating an epistemological framework that preserves human agency' yang menunjukkan argumen untuk keseimbangan. Ini menguji reading comprehension tingkat C1 dalam mengidentifikasi nuanced argument yang menyajikan perspektif berimbang daripada posisi ekstrem.

quiz.question: [Reading Comprehension] Passage: 'Contemporary literary criticism has shifted from structuralist interpretations, which privileged textual autonomy, toward reader-response theories that acknowledge the co-construction of meaning. This paradigmatic transition reflects broader epistemological shifts in the humanities, wherein the notion of objective interpretation has been supplanted by recognition of interpretive plurality. Nevertheless, this relativistic turn has engendered legitimate concerns regarding critical standards and evaluative criteria.' What transition does the passage describe?
options: From objective to subjective interpretation methods
From reader focus to text-centered analysis
From traditional to digital literary studies
From theoretical to practical criticism approaches
quiz.answer: From objective to subjective interpretation methods
quiz.explanation: Passage menjelaskan perpindahan dari 'textual autonomy' dan 'objective interpretation' menuju 'reader-response theories' dan 'interpretive plurality', yang merupakan pergeseran dari objektif ke subjektif. Ini menguji kemampuan mengidentifikasi transisi teoretis kompleks dalam academic discourse.

quiz.question: [Reading Comprehension] Passage: 'The efficacy of remote work arrangements remains contentious. Proponents cite enhanced work-life balance and reduced commuting costs, while critics highlight decreased spontaneous collaboration and potential erosion of organizational culture. Empirical evidence, however, reveals a more nuanced reality: productivity metrics vary substantially across sectors and individual roles, precluding sweeping generalizations about remote work's universal applicability.' What does the author suggest about remote work research?
options: Remote work universally increases productivity
Organizational culture always suffers in remote settings
Context-specific factors determine remote work success
Empirical evidence definitively favors traditional office work
quiz.answer: Context-specific factors determine remote work success
quiz.explanation: Penulis menyatakan bahwa 'productivity metrics vary substantially across sectors and individual roles, precluding sweeping generalizations' yang menunjukkan bahwa konteks menentukan kesuksesan. Ini menguji kemampuan memahami hedged conclusions dan nuanced arguments dalam academic writing.

quiz.question: [Reading Comprehension] Passage: 'Sustainable development, as articulated in the Brundtland Report, necessitates meeting present needs without compromising future generations' capacity to meet theirs. This principle, though widely endorsed, proves inherently ambiguous in practice. The temporal horizon for 'future generations' remains undefined, intergenerational equity metrics lack consensus, and the trade-offs between economic development and environmental preservation resist straightforward quantification.' The passage suggests that sustainable development is:
options: A clearly defined and easily implementable concept
Theoretically sound but practically challenging to operationalize
Primarily concerned with immediate economic benefits
Universally rejected by development economists
quiz.answer: Theoretically sound but practically challenging to operationalize
quiz.explanation: Penulis menyatakan prinsip tersebut 'widely endorsed' tetapi 'proves inherently ambiguous in practice' dan mendaftar berbagai tantangan implementasi. Ini menguji kemampuan mengidentifikasi gap antara teori dan praktik dalam academic discourse dan memahami critical analysis.

quiz.question: [Writing & Grammar] Which sentence correctly uses a gerund after a preposition in a formal academic context?
options: The research methodology succeeded in to demonstrate the correlation between variables.
The team is committed to implement sustainable practices throughout the organization.
Prior to conducting the experiment, researchers obtained ethical clearance from the board.
The policy aims at to reduce carbon emissions by implementing stricter regulations.
quiz.answer: Prior to conducting the experiment, researchers obtained ethical clearance from the board.
quiz.explanation: Setelah preposisi 'to' (dalam 'prior to'), harus diikuti gerund bukan infinitive. Kalimat ini benar menggunakan 'conducting' bukan 'to conduct'. Pilihan lain salah karena menggunakan infinitive setelah preposisi ('in to', 'at to') atau menggunakan infinitive setelah 'committed to' yang seharusnya diikuti gerund.

quiz.question: [Writing & Grammar] Select the sentence with the correctly punctuated non-defining relative clause:
options: The hypothesis which was proposed by Dr. Martinez has been thoroughly validated.
Participants who failed to complete the survey were excluded from the analysis.
The intervention, which lasted six months, demonstrated significant effectiveness.
Research that contradicts established theories often faces rigorous scrutiny.
quiz.answer: The intervention, which lasted six months, demonstrated significant effectiveness.
quiz.explanation: Non-defining relative clause memberikan informasi tambahan (non-esensial) dan harus diapit koma. 'The intervention' sudah spesifik, jadi durasi enam bulan adalah informasi tambahan. Pilihan A dan D menggunakan relative clause tanpa koma yang benar hanya untuk defining clauses. Pilihan B benar untuk defining clause karena 'who failed' adalah informasi esensial untuk mengidentifikasi partisipan mana.

quiz.question: [Writing & Grammar] Which sentence demonstrates correct use of a participle clause for cause and effect?
options: Analyzing the data, the results were found to be statistically significant.
Having analyzed the data, the researchers concluded the results were significant.
The data being analyzed, significant results were discovered by the team.
Analyzed the data, researchers finding the results were statistically significant.
quiz.answer: Having analyzed the data, the researchers concluded the results were significant.
quiz.explanation: Participle clause 'Having analyzed the data' dengan benar memiliki subject yang sama dengan main clause ('the researchers'). Ini menghindari dangling participle error. Pilihan A salah karena subject participle ('analyzing') adalah researchers tapi subject main clause adalah 'results' (dangling participle). Pilihan C dan D memiliki struktur gramatikal yang salah.

quiz.question: [Writing & Grammar] Choose the sentence with appropriate hedging language for academic writing:
options: The data proves definitively that climate change is caused exclusively by human activity.
These findings suggest that there may be a correlation between diet and cognitive function.
This research shows without any doubt that the intervention always works effectively.
The results demonstrate absolute certainty regarding the universal applicability of this theory.
quiz.answer: These findings suggest that there may be a correlation between diet and cognitive function.
quiz.explanation: Hedging language ('suggest', 'may be') digunakan untuk mengekspresikan caution dalam klaim akademis. Ini menunjukkan kesadaran bahwa penelitian memiliki keterbatasan dan tidak membuat overgeneralization. Pilihan lain menggunakan bahasa yang terlalu absolut ('proves definitively', 'without any doubt', 'absolute certainty') yang tidak tepat untuk academic discourse.

quiz.question: [Speaking & Situational Dialogue] You're presenting research to senior academics who question your methodology. Which response demonstrates appropriate diplomatic register?
options: Your concerns are wrong because you don't understand the advanced statistical methods I used.
I appreciate your feedback, though I must respectfully note that the methodology has been validated through peer review.
That's a ridiculous criticism and shows you haven't read the literature on this topic properly.
While I acknowledge your perspective, I would suggest that alternative methodologies might warrant consideration.
quiz.answer: While I acknowledge your perspective, I would suggest that alternative methodologies might warrant consideration.
quiz.explanation: Respons ini menunjukkan diplomatic language dengan 'acknowledge your perspective' dan tentative language 'might warrant consideration' yang membuka dialog tanpa defensive atau dismissive. Pilihan A dan C terlalu konfrontatif dan tidak profesional. Pilihan B lebih baik tapi kurang diplomatic karena langsung mencounter dengan appeal to authority ('peer review').

quiz.question: [Speaking & Situational Dialogue] During a negotiation, a colleague dismisses your proposal. Which response best demonstrates C1-level diplomatic argumentation?
options: I think you're making a mistake by rejecting this without proper consideration of the facts.
That's your opinion, but the data clearly supports my position regardless of what you think.
I understand your reservations. Perhaps we could explore how elements of this proposal might address your specific concerns?
You need to reconsider because this is obviously the best solution for our current situation.
quiz.answer: I understand your reservations. Perhaps we could explore how elements of this proposal might address your specific concerns?
quiz.explanation: Respons ini menunjukkan active listening ('understand your reservations'), tentative language ('perhaps'), dan collaborative approach ('explore... elements') yang diplomatic. Ini membuka ruang negosiasi tanpa meninggalkan posisi awal. Pilihan lain terlalu assertive atau confrontational dan tidak menunjukkan diplomatic negotiation skills.

quiz.question: [Speaking & Situational Dialogue] You need to diplomatically disagree with a supervisor's interpretation of results. Which approach is most appropriate?
options: With respect, I wonder whether we might interpret the data slightly differently if we consider the confidence intervals.
I'm afraid you've misunderstood the statistical analysis and drawn incorrect conclusions from it.
Actually, that interpretation is technically incorrect based on standard statistical practices.
I disagree completely with that interpretation because the data obviously shows something different.
quiz.answer: With respect, I wonder whether we might interpret the data slightly differently if we consider the confidence intervals.
quiz.explanation: Respons ini menggunakan multiple diplomatic strategies: respectful opening ('With respect'), tentative language ('wonder whether', 'might'), hedging ('slightly differently'), dan menawarkan alternative interpretation dengan evidence-based reasoning. Ini memungkinkan supervisor untuk reconsider tanpa losing face. Pilihan lain terlalu direct atau accusatory.

quiz.question: [Speaking & Situational Dialogue] In a high-stakes meeting, you must present a counterargument to a popular proposal. Which opening is most diplomatically effective?
options: While I recognize the merits of this approach, I'd like to suggest we consider some potential implications that may warrant further discussion.
This proposal has several obvious flaws that need to be addressed before we can move forward with it.
I have to say that I think this idea won't work based on my experience in this field.
Everyone seems to support this, but I believe there are serious problems we're overlooking here.
quiz.answer: While I recognize the merits of this approach, I'd like to suggest we consider some potential implications that may warrant further discussion.
quiz.explanation: Opening ini menunjukkan sophisticated diplomatic argumentation: acknowledge opposing view ('recognize the merits'), tentative language ('suggest', 'may warrant'), neutral framing ('implications' bukan 'problems'), dan collaborative tone ('we consider'). Ini memposisikan counterargument sebagai contribution to discussion daripada opposition, yang crucial dalam high-stakes professional contexts.

modules.title: Advanced Academic Hedging & Nuanced Modality
modules.objective: Menguasai teknik hedging akademis (it would appear that, arguably, conceivably, tends to suggest) untuk memaparkan klaim saintifik secara terukur.

theory.summary: Hedging akademis adalah strategi linguistik yang digunakan dalam penulisan dan presentasi ilmiah untuk menyampaikan klaim dengan tingkat kepastian yang terukur. Berbeda dengan pernyataan absolut, hedging memungkinkan penulis untuk menunjukkan kehati-hatian epistemik, mengakui keterbatasan penelitian, dan menghindari overgeneralisasi. Teknik ini sangat penting dalam konteks akademis karena menunjukkan integritas intelektual dan kesadaran akan kompleksitas fenomena yang diteliti. Di level C1, Anda diharapkan dapat menggunakan berbagai perangkat hedging—mulai dari modal verbs (might, could, may), epistemic adverbs (arguably, conceivably, presumably), hingga konstruksi impersonal (it would appear that, there seems to be evidence suggesting)—secara fleksibel sesuai dengan tingkat kepastian data dan konteks retoris.
rules: Gunakan modal verbs untuk mengekspresikan berbagai tingkat kemungkinan: 'may/might/could + infinitive' untuk kemungkinan rendah hingga sedang; 'would' untuk kondisional atau kesimpulan yang didasarkan pada premis tertentu. Contoh: 'The data might suggest a correlation' (kemungkinan rendah), 'This would indicate a causal relationship' (kesimpulan kondisional).

Gunakan epistemic adverbs dan adjuncts untuk mengkualifikasi klaim: 'arguably, conceivably, presumably, ostensibly, purportedly, allegedly' ditempatkan di awal atau tengah kalimat untuk menunjukkan stance penulis. Formula: [Epistemic adverb] + [Subject] + [Verb] + [Complement]. Contoh: 'Arguably, this methodology presents certain limitations' atau 'The results, conceivably, could be attributed to external factors'.

Gunakan konstruksi impersonal dan evaluative untuk menciptakan jarak objektif: 'It would appear that...', 'There seems to be evidence suggesting...', 'The findings tend to indicate...'. Formula: [Impersonal subject] + [tentative verb] + [that-clause/to-infinitive]. Contoh: 'It would appear that the hypothesis requires further validation' menunjukkan kehati-hatian yang lebih tinggi daripada 'The hypothesis is invalid'.

commonTrap.trapTitle: Overhhedging dan Underhedging
commonTrap.explanation: Kesalahan umum di level C1 adalah menggunakan terlalu banyak hedging devices dalam satu kalimat (overhedging) sehingga klaim menjadi tidak jelas, atau menggunakan hedging yang terlalu lemah untuk klaim yang didukung data kuat (underhedging). Overhedging merusak kredibilitas akademis karena terkesan tidak percaya diri, sementara underhedging dapat membuat klaim terdengar dogmatis.
commonTrap.wrong: It might possibly perhaps be conceivably argued that there could potentially be some evidence suggesting...
commonTrap.correct: The evidence would seem to suggest that... OR It could be argued that the data indicate...

readinessQuestions.prompt: Manakah pernyataan yang BENAR mengenai kaidah pada topik "Advanced Academic Hedging & Nuanced Modality"?
options: Pola ini hanya boleh digunakan dalam situasi santai
Tenses dan susunan subjek tidak perlu diperhatikan
Gunakan modal verbs untuk mengekspresikan berbagai tingkat kemungkinan: 'may/might/coul...
